charts.where: effort-curve chart (svg#effort-curve-tb3): "Pass rate against tokens spent, by effort setting", Terminal-Bench 3.0, 70 tasks
charts.checks: SVG vector circles: cx/cy are exact coordinates of the markers. x: log10(tokens) is linear in cx through the four tick labels 50k/100k/200k/300k (consistent to 2e-4 in log10); y: linear in cy through the six gridlines 20%..70% (labels sit 5 px above their gridline). Values are the fitted ones: pass rate rounded to 0.01 point and tokens to the unit; the page is rendered inside <g transform="translate(20 66)">, a common translation that does not change the calibration.
